label: Volleyball at the 2020 Summer Olympics (Tokyo) - Women's tournament, 15th edition (played 2021)
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-3 (PLAN-VB). Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); per-row sources = official FIVB vis2009 Results PDFs (getdocument.asmx ids 256318281-256321067, all 38 distinct) + olympics.com statistics PDFs in provenance; format census 2 pools of 6 RR (30) + QF/SF/3P/F (8) = 38 == built count. TOKYO-2020 PLAYED 2021: postponed by COVID-19 (IOC/Tokyo-2020 joint statement cited in-page), all matches behind closed doors at Ariake Arena, Tokyo - single-venue edition, edition_year 2021 = year actually played. FIDELITY: per-team pool points recomputed from set tokens == standings spw/spl for ALL 12 TEAMS (dual official standings source in-page: olympics.com groups page + volleyballworld standings). Spine exact: SF participants == QF winners == {USA,BRA,SRB,KOR}, F == SF winners, 3P == SF losers. QF pairings by drawing of lots (2nd v 2nd, 3rd v 3rd - the 2008-Beijing repeat noted in-page). Champions USA - FIRST Olympic gold after THREE runner-up finishes (1984, 2008, 2012), d. Brazil 3-0 in the final ('Drews shines' FIVB ref); Serbia bronze 3-0 over South Korea (Boskovic 33 points in the bronze match, best scorer 192 overall; Kim Yeon-koung's farewell run to 4th preserved incl. the QF 3-2 over Turkiye 15-13 fifth and the 3-2 pool win over host Japan 16-14 fifth). Host Japan OUT IN POOLS (5th in Pool A, 1 win) - home flags on all 5 JPN rows; Tandara (BRA) suspended before the SF after a positive out-of-competition test for Enobosarm (Reuters ref cited in-page - roster event, no match affected, zero forfeits). ROC as-printed per DATA-RULES adjudication; ROC beat eventual champions USA 3-0 in pools - preserved. 25 Jul - 8 Aug 2021.
